supersedes: The 22mm prototype and its fabrication/render handoff are not the requested product.
coordinate_system: Portrait front view: X right, Y down; origin upper-left; Z from rear exterior towards screen; all mm. Port datums are external opening centers, NOT KiCad footprint origins.
board_architecture: Two separate coplanar PCBs, not a vertically stacked board pair; these regions allocate placement space, not a populated native layout.

battery.note: Complete protected pack including PCM, tabs and lead exit. These are procurement constraints, not proof a suitable 2.8mm pack exists. Do not silently reduce capacity or remove protection.

J201.mounting: reviewed mid-mount footprint required if body overlaps panel

required_ecos.C301: Replace the 6.5mm-high RTC backup capacitor with a reviewed thin backup assembly; preserve isolated >=24h time retention. Cell chemistry and any charging path must be reviewed together.
required_ecos.U501: The 3.2mm WROOM-1U cannot satisfy this 2.4mm mounted-height allocation. Evaluate ESP32-S3R8 plus domestic 16MB Flash, crystal and RF network; preserve 8MB PSRAM, GPIO2 inhibit, functionality and antenna clearance. No unverified new MPN is released.
required_ecos.J301_J302_J502: Replace tall wire housings with reviewed low-profile mainland parts or a qualified solder harness with strain relief.
required_ecos.J601_J1: Replace the stacked connector arrangement with a low-profile flexible link; preserve signal and power/ground mappings and review SI/current capability.
required_ecos.J201: Relocate to bottom center; independently qualify exact mid-mount package, PCB cutout, shell anchoring, CC/ESD wiring and plug clearance.
required_ecos.J501: Relocate to the right lower corner; reroute the complete SD bus, retain pullups/series parts, review card insertion/ejection and edge strength.
